## 💡 What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the underlying need — *why* you want this, not just the solution.

## 🎯 Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen.

## 🔀 Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## 🎮 Which part of the game?

- [ ] Gameplay / balance
- [ ] Enemies or bosses
- [ ] Weapons or items
- [ ] Modes (Endless / Campaign / Daily / Training)
- [ ] Controls (keyboard / touch / gamepad)
- [ ] UI, HUD or menus
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Other: ______

## 📝 Anything else?

Mockups, references, extra context.
